notes:
Sidetable now updates itself: a new version installs between sessions, never during one.
Tournaments by day, with or without PokerCraft: buy-in, time played, hands and last blinds.
A stream element for OBS that shows counts only: no names, tables or money.
Clearer Settings and Report, and net per hour for fully linked sessions.
Fixes from real sessions: a table that moves windows stays one table; PokerCraft times read in your zone.
